build_RGBDTPreprocessor: build a multimodal preprocessor that tokenizes RGB and depth inputs with positional embeddings and CLS tokens
build_TextPreprocessor: build a text preprocessor that embeds tokenized text with optional causal masking and positional embeddings
build_SimpleTokenizer: build a BPE-based tokenizer that encodes and decodes text with start and end of text tokens
build_IMUPreprocessor: build an IMU preprocessor that patchifies sensor data and produces tokens with positional embeddings
build_AudioPreprocessor: build an audio preprocessor that tokenizes audio inputs using a patch embedding stem with CLS tokens
